Source [ORACLE]:WITH rollover_excluded_mbrs AS (

  SELECT 
  DISTINCT mp.mbi,
  mp.member_profile_id_nh,
  mp.business_id_nh 
  FROM mbrprofile.health_coverage hc 

  INNER JOIN mbrprofile.member_profile mp 
  ON hc.member_profile_id_nh=mp.member_profile_id_nh 

  WHERE hc.benefit_begin_dt BETWEEN TO_DATE('01012027', 'MMDDYYYY') 
  AND TO_DATE('12312027', 'MMDDYYYY') 

  AND hc.benefit_end_dt BETWEEN TO_DATE('01012027', 'MMDDYYYY') 
  AND TO_DATE('12312027', 'MMDDYYYY')

  AND hc.enrollment_status_id IN (200004,
  200005) 

  AND sep_reason<>'SEP_ROL' 

  UNION ALL 

  SELECT 
  DISTINCT mbi,
  mbr.member_profile_id_nh,
  mbr.business_id_nh 
  FROM mbrexcep.member mbr

  INNER JOIN mbrexcep.member_error mbr_er 
  ON mbr.member_id_nh=mbr_er.member_id_nh 
  AND mbr_er.error_status_id=170105 

  INNER JOIN mbrexcep.health_coverage hc 
  ON mbr.member_id_nh=hc.member_id_nh 

  WHERE mbr.maintenance_type_code='021' 

  AND TO_DATE(hc.benefit_begin_dt DEFAULT NULL 
  ON CONVERSION ERROR, 'YYYYMMDD')BETWEEN TO_DATE('01012027', 'MMDDYYYY')
  AND TO_DATE('12312027', 'MMDDYYYY')

  AND TO_DATE(hc.benefit_end_dt DEFAULT NULL 
  ON CONVERSION ERROR, 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN TO_DATE('01012027', 'MMDDYYYY') 
  AND TO_DATE('12312027', 'MMDDYYYY')

  UNION ALL 

  SELECT 
  DISTINCT mp.mbi,
  mp.member_profile_id_nh,
  mp.business_id_nh 
  FROM mbrprofile.member_profile mp

  INNER JOIN mbrprofile.health_coverage hc 
  ON mp.member_profile_id_nh=hc.member_profile_id_nh

  WHERE hc.enrollment_status_id=200004 

  AND trunc(hc.benefit_begin_dt) BETWEEN TO_DATE('01012026', 'MMDDYYYY') 
  AND TO_DATE('12312026', 'MMDDYYYY')

  AND trunc(hc.benefit_end_dt)=TO_DATE('12312026', 'MMDDYYYY') 

  AND hc.term_rsn_code IS NULL 

  AND hc.plan_id='H3551002000'

  UNION ALL

  SELECT 
  DISTINCT mp.mbi,
  mp.member_profile_id_nh,
  mp.business_id_nh

  ON mp.member_profile_id_nh=hc.member_profile_id_nh 

  INNER JOIN mbrprofile.mbr_address ma 
  ON mp.member_profile_id_nh=ma.member_profile_id_nh 

  AND upper(ma.address_type)='RESIDENTIAL'

  AND upper(ma.county)='PIMA' 

  WHERE hc.enrollment_status_id=200004

  AND TO_DATE('12312026', 'MMDDYYYY') 

  AND trunc(hc.benefit_end_dt)=TO_DATE('12312026', 'MMDDYYYY')

  AND hc.term_rsn_code IS NULL

  AND hc.plan_id LIKE'H3551004%')
